attacks.name: Hypnosis Gas
steps: After this attack is resolved, this character gains |!power| equal to the |!damage| dealt.
After this attack is resolved, if it dealt |!damage|, this character may advance the defender |!range_small|.

attacks.name: Curtain Call
steps: If this attack deals |!damage| and the defender is |!size| 2 or less, after this attack is resolved, this character may Throw the defender |!range_small|.
|!wild| |*Stagger|: After this attack is resolved, the defender gains the |§stagger§Stagger| special condition.

superPowers.name: Tricks and Traps
superPowers.body: When an enemy character ends a movement within |!range| 3 of this character, this character may use this superpower. Roll 4 dice. That enemy character suffers 1 |!damage| for each |!critical| and |!wild| rolled. If this superpower deals at least 1 |!damage|, this character may Advance |!range_small|.

superPowers.name: Master of Illusions
superPowers.body: Whenever this character rolls dice, after the effect is resolved, it gains 1 |!power| if it rolled at least 1 Blank. Additionally, this character uses its |!mystic| Defense when making a dodge roll.

superPowers.name: Smoke and Mirrors
superPowers.body: When an enemy character targets this character with an attack, this character may use its |!mystic| Defense regardless of the attack's type, unless the attacking character pays 2 |!power|.

superPowers.name: Stealth
superPowers.body: Characters must be within |!range| 3 of this character to target it with attacks.
